days_note: common day set = days >= first full feature row where all 5 CPCV paths and v1 are non-NaN (4128); 5 days with v1 present but some path NaN dropped (days not covered by every path); previous run used per-path day sets (4129 each) for the point estimate and 4133 for the bootstrap
headline_note: clean_ann_sharpe = mean over paths of per-path annualised Sharpe (matches its CI); v1 Sharpe on the common day set
clean_ann_sharpe_avg_series_note: Sharpe of the 5-path averaged return series; diversified, not the prereg statistic
sr_var_note: v2 family variance of daily Sharpe (96 configs)

bootstrap.stat: mean over paths of (ann Sharpe(clean path) - ann Sharpe(v1)); joint day resampling

note: 2001-2017 CPCV (6 groups, 2 test, purge 252, embargo 21); signal close t, trade t+1; v1 costs and rolls; not out-of-sample for the researcher; costs/slippage as v1, capacity not assessed. Warm-up days before first full feature row excluded for both books. Design bias: in each split the clean book holds zero positions outside its test groups, so entering a test group incurs entry turnover cost while v1 trades continuously; this is a conservative bias against the clean book.
